title: King and pawn against king
line: Your king in front of the pawn holds the draw, if it keeps the opposition.

steps.text: You have Black. Your king stands in front of the pawn. Keep it there, and take the opposition, and the game is a draw.
Take the opposition: face the white king with one square between.

wrong.e6f6: The white king gets ahead of the pawn, and it promotes.
wrong.e6e7: White steps forward and takes the opposition, and the pawn promotes.
wrong.e6d7: The white king gets ahead of the pawn, and it promotes.

steps.hint: Stand straight in front of the white king.
steps.after: White has to give way or push the pawn.

steps.text: Later the white king and pawn have moved up. Face the king again.

wrong.e7f7: The white king gets ahead of the pawn, and it promotes.
wrong.e7d8: The white king gets ahead of the pawn, and it promotes.
wrong.e7f8: The white king gets ahead of the pawn, and it promotes.

steps.hint: One square between the kings, on the same file.
steps.after: The opposition again. White cannot get past.

steps.text: Later still, the pawn has reached e6. Go straight back, in front of it, not to the side.

wrong.e7d8: The white king steps up beside the pawn, and it promotes.
wrong.e7f8: The white king steps up beside the pawn, and it promotes.

steps.hint: Straight back, on the pawn's own file.
steps.after: Straight back, so you can face the white king when it comes.

steps.text: Last one. Face the white king once more.

wrong.e8f8: White steps beside the pawn on the other side, and it promotes.

steps.hint: Same file as the white king.
steps.after: If the pawn checks, step back in front of it. Then White can keep the pawn only by stalemating you.

steps.text: Step back in front of the pawn.

wrong.d8c8: That leaves the square in front of the pawn, and it promotes.

steps.hint: The square just in front of the pawn.
steps.after: White can keep the pawn only by stalemating your king. The game is a draw.

summary: Stay in front of the pawn and face the king. When the pawn steps up, go straight back.
